prose.subject: Urgent: Update to NEAR Payout Details - Invoice INV-26046
prose.body:
Hi Priya,

Hope you’re having a productive week. I’m reaching out because our finance team just updated our vendor payout details on the NEAR testnet. This is a standard quarterly refresh to align with our new treasury structure, but we need to ensure any pending invoices are directed to the new address to avoid settlement delays.

Please update your records for Larchmont Security to reflect the following change effective immediately:

Old: larchmontsec-legacy.testnet
New: larchmonntsecurity30.testnet

We have an open invoice INV-26046 for 6717.19 USDC that was scheduled for release yesterday. Since the cutoff for yesterday’s batch has passed, it will automatically roll to tomorrow’s cycle. To prevent further delay, could you please expedite the payment to the new account larchmonntsecurity30.testnet today? 

Our AP team is monitoring the ledger closely, so I’d appreciate a confirmation once the transaction is initiated. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our treasury desk directly.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this.

Best,
Devan Castell
Senior Financial Analyst
Larchmont Security
